$comment: Provenance and rip-risk check of every asset in manager-assets.json plus the Suzuka/Monaco/Nürburgring candidates in the f1-3d-assets repo. Method, 2026-11-22: read each Sketchfab model (title, description, tags, licence, uploader) through the public API https://api.sketchfab.com/v3/models/<uid>, the uploader profiles (/v3/users/<uid>) and a sample of each main uploader's other uploads (/v3/search?type=models&user=<username>; 403 for Tyler_Dave, 24 for SidewalkNZ), at about 1 request per second. Combined with offline GLB evidence (material, node and source-file names read from the JSON chunk of tools/assets/.cache/raw/*). riskRipped: true = rip, or a re-upload of third-party work by someone who is not the author; false = positive evidence of own work and no rip signs; null = cannot decide. All 63 checked pages are still online and still say CC Attribution 4.0, so the licence matches the manifest and ATTRIBUTION files everywhere. Cars are keyed by season+teamRef and circuits by splineId+release, as in the manifest; candidates have candidate=true, candidateFor and release (circuitos-<folder slug>). Extended on 2026-11-22 with the 91 cars of the other playable seasons (1976-2026), same method: Sketchfab model API, uploader profiles and the names inside each GLB (gMotor/rFactor, Codemasters F1, Assetto Corsa and Roblox signatures).

Dave Love SketchFab.summary: Re-uploader, not an original author. Bio says he usually uses other people's models and repaints them; uploads credit third parties (Outpiston, MattDoesBlender, Tk3cuasoc (Roblox), Qwertyazzertyx, amogusstrikesback2) and every circuit is self-tagged 'Ripped' + 'asseto-corsa' + 'ripped-model'. Joined 2025-05-16, ~435 models. The CC BY 4.0 label is applied by the uploader and cannot be trusted as a grant from the rights holder.
evidence: Profile bio (API https://api.sketchfab.com/v3/users/d00fd6e7881e43d4821e30a82d10dbf7): "i often upload a model that the whole Sketchfab doesnt have it, i usually use others models and repaint"

37 of 403 listed uploads carry the tags 'ripped', 'ripped-model', 'asseto-corsa', 'asseto-corsa-3d-model' (API search https://api.sketchfab.com/v3/search?type=models&user=Tyler_Dave), including all 8 circuits in the manifest.

'Lockheed C-130 Hercules' description: "Idk why i found this plane mod on ASSETTOCORSAMODS.IO" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/5acfb2eb4f204f51ab418856c116b68e)
'Delta Airlines Airbus A350-900': "Model: by Outpiston (yep, again, rlly sorry) Texture: by me" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/b108d460122f4113960e000fc6f2ad44)
'1994 Williams FW16': "Credit: Model by Tk3cuasoc (Roblox)", tags vecarz, mattdoesblender (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/40a93cc3b4d64c489a19ab1eff27bd4a)

Car descriptions are copied from Wikipedia plus Pinterest/Wikimedia photos; none of the 66 car uploads claims own modelling.

GLB internals of the cars use ISI gMotor livery material names (WCCARBODY, WCEXTRA0/1, used by EA Sports F1 2002 / F1 Challenge 99-02 and rFactor mods) and mod-team tokens such as CTDP_TECH (CTDP rFactor F1 mod team) and the 'cim_' node prefix.
